links.outcome: Differential diagnosis accuracy (top-1, top-5) of GPT models versus radiologists
links.effect: Top-1: radiologists 1.00, GPT-4 0.54, GPT-3.5 0.54, GPT-2 0.21; Top-5: 1.00, 0.96, 0.89, 0.54. GPT impression and differential diagnosis scores significantly lower than radiologists (p<0.05).
links.quote: However, qualitative scores of the GPT series in impression and differential diagnosis scores were significantly lower than those of radiologists (p < 0.05).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the standalone capability of GPT models (GPT-2, GPT-3.5, GPT-4) to generate radiology reports from concise findings retrospectively, compared to radiologist-generated reports, without testing an organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
